splits_metadata.methodology: Deterministic grouped stratification by pair-level label with incident_id boundary preservation
splits_metadata.deviationExplanation: Zero deviation: 400 total records and individual class totals (120, 140, 140) are divisible by 5, matching exact 60.0% / 20.0% / 20.0% split targets with 0 group leakage.

evaluation_sequencing_protocol.rule: Held-out Test (N=80) and Synthetic Challenge (N=150) remain strictly withheld and unevaluated during T2.
evaluation_sequencing_protocol.held_out_status: TEST and CHALLENGE partitions withheld and unevaluated during T2.

metadata.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

hybrid_selection.rationale: Both candidates achieved 1.0000 Macro F1 and 1.0000 Accuracy; HISC_hybrid_max selected via Rule 5 (larger threshold margin: 0.65 vs 0.60).

B6_embedding.formula: S = Cosine(e_A, e_B) using Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 normalized mean-pooled vectors.
B6_embedding.fitting_notes: Zero-shot neural semantic baseline; decision thresholds tuned strictly on validation.
B6_embedding.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

HISC_embed.formula: Weighted multi-attribute affinity: S = 0.20*Cat + 0.25*Geo + 0.10*Lex + 0.30*S_embed + 0.15*Time with contextual rules.
HISC_embed.fitting_notes: Replaces lexical/synonym semantic component with embedding cosine; hand-fixed domain weights preserved.
HISC_embed.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

HISC_hybrid_mean.formula: S_sem = 0.5 * S_dictionary + 0.5 * S_embedding in HISC multi-attribute scorer.
HISC_hybrid_mean.fitting_notes: Convex average of synonym-dictionary and neural embedding semantic affinities.
HISC_hybrid_mean.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

HISC_hybrid_max.formula: S_sem = max(S_dictionary, S_embedding) in HISC multi-attribute scorer.
HISC_hybrid_max.fitting_notes: Maximum affinity selector uniting synonym coverage and semantic representation.
HISC_hybrid_max.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

HISC.formula: Weighted multi-attribute affinity: S = 0.20*Cat + 0.25*Geo + 0.10*Lex + 0.30*Sem + 0.15*Time with contextual classification rules. Default thresholds: 0.60 / 0.35.
HISC.fitting_notes: Hand-fixed domain weights; no training set fitting.

tuning_summary.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

B1_jaccard.formula: S = |Tokens_A ∩ Tokens_B| / |Tokens_A ∪ Tokens_B| on normalized alphanumeric word tokens.

tuning_summary.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

B2_distance.formula: S = exp(-d / 1000) where d is Haversine distance in meters.
B2_distance.fitting_notes: None (zero-shot spatial baseline with fixed scale 1000m).

tuning_summary.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

B3_cat_distance.formula: S = 0.5 * CategoryScore(cat_A, cat_B) + 0.5 * exp(-d / 1000). Equal 50/50 convex weighting.

tuning_summary.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

B4_tfidf.formula: S = Cosine(v_A, v_B) where term vectors v use smoothed IDF = ln((N+1)/(df+1)) + 1, fitted strictly on TRAIN texts.
B4_tfidf.fitting_notes: Fitted on 240 train pairs (480 complaint texts, vocabulary size: 97). Val/test/challenge out-of-vocabulary terms ignored.

tuning_summary.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.

B5_tfidf_distance.formula: S = 0.6 * S_tfidf + 0.4 * exp(-d / 1000). Fixed 60/40 convex combination formula.
B5_tfidf_distance.fitting_notes: TF-IDF vocabulary and IDF fitted strictly on TRAIN texts. Combination weights 0.6/0.4 fixed by design, not tuned on validation.

tuning_summary.tie_break_rule: 1. Highest validation macro F1 -> 2. Highest overall accuracy -> 3. Highest duplicate F1 -> 4. Highest related F1 -> 5. Highest threshold margin (dt - rt) -> 6. Descending (dt, rt) lexicographical order.
